p.s: I can say that I agree with the statement.
Nowadays, young people spend too much time for themself.
In fact, they stay a lot of time in own house to play with the video games or to watch the television and rarely to study something.
First of all, I believe that the tecnology and all the things around it have contribuited to damage the personality of the youth.
In the past, a boy or a girl had to help their family in the fields or in home because their family obligated them to do something of useful.
The boys improved very quickly their skills and they grown faster than the modern boys.
The girl learnd how to cook and how to repair the clothes of their parents because it was a necessity.
The modern young people have the possibility to get every things that they want because their parents do not oppose resistant over all requests.
In fact, I believe that the new parents are too much flexible and permissive.
They should be more strict to allow to understand to their sons what things are important and what are not.
So, nowadays, the young people are more material than in the past so they do not mind if the society around them is going to fall down in a big depression.
For example, I saw a lot of people do not interest of the news or the newspapers a little thing that push a person to think about the real world.
Finally, the modern young people are too much influenced to the society.
They see their friends behave in a particular way and understand that they can get some thing in that way.
They do not spend time to help their communities becouse the modern communities offer all thing that a young need.
Therefore, a boy or a girl does not look for something of interesting to do.
I think that it is the main reason in the decline of the youth.
